resources.string: Search operators
Search operators
Refine your query with phrase, required and excluded terms.
Example:
Works on a phrase too:
Close
Phrase match
Wrap words in double quotes to match them in that exact order, next to each other.
matches only photos where those two words appear together in that order.
On its own, a phrase applies to the keyword side of the search. Turn AI off for it to filter results. With + or - in front, a phrase always filters.
Required term
Prefix a word with + to force it into every result. Other (unprefixed) words still influence ranking but aren\'t mandatory.
every result must contain \"laptop\"; size and \"gaming\" just boost matching photos.
every result must contain those two words together, in that order.
Exclude term
Prefix with - to drop any photo containing that word.
hides all refurbished laptops from the results.
drops every photo containing that exact phrase.
Combine them
All three operators compose freely in one query.
must contain \"laptop\" and the exact phrase \"13 inch\", excludes anything refurbished.
Why this matters with AI on

AI search can bring up similar photos that aren\'t what you wanted: searching laptop 1000 GB may also pull in external hard drives with similar specs. Using +laptop forces the keyword match and cleans those out instantly.
